newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: INSIGHT-Dutch chartists positive but shy about AEX.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT-Dutch chartists positive but shy about AEX.

text.p: Dutch chartists stayed bullish about the AEX index of 25 leading shares but many were reticent about pin-pointing where overhead resistance might kick in as the bull market continues.
The AEX index ended at a record high 907.19 points on Friday, back from an intra-day peak of 911.25, and 36.74 points above the previous Friday's closing.
In the week before that the index had gained 8.25 points. The index on Monday afternoon stood at 917.73, up 41.6 percent since the beginning of 1997.

Note - Contributors' own analysis follows.
ABN AMRO - This is still a long market. Stick to your bullish scenario. To calculate new targets, we first need new corrections, so no new targets for now.

JAAD - The strong trend in which the market is currently involved has moved upward without consolidation patterns along the way. This causes the support levels to stay at a far distance from the current price (a sure signal for an insecure, maybe overstretched market).
Market weather for the coming days: The Sun is still shining brightly but watch out for summer thunderstorms.

ING Barings - Investors seem to be surprised as the AEX has breached the upper side of the steep rising trend channel around 890. Confirmed by surging prices towards an intra-day high of 911.25 last Friday.
The start of this new acceleration phase within the uptrend above 890 has been accompanied by heavy volumes, indicating very active buying during the recent breakout.
Solid technicals as momentum and A/D ratios are improving further, confirming the bullish outlook. There is indication of likely higher prices around our first objective at 920-925.

ING Barings (cont) - However, be alert as the 12 day average of the call/put ratio is showing overheated readings, signalling extreme optimism, possibly suggesting that profit-taking might occur any time soon.

MeesPierson - It becoms a boring story as the markets keep very strong. The index is still moving in an upward trading range. We expect some profit taking during the coming days, nevertheless the closing level of this week will probably be higher again...We still advise investors to use the possible slowdown to buy Dutch shares.
RABO Securities - Breaking out of the rising channel, once again generated a strong buy signal for the AEX. Our next target is now found at 920.
